DTC e-commerce business

Profit and Stock Intelligence

Rebuilding the data flow behind profit, inventory, and reorder decisions

I corrected the transaction source and delivered a working decision system for margin, stock health, and replenishment.

Situation

Order, product, cost, and inventory data were fragmented, making daily profitability, stock-depletion, and replenishment decisions harder to support from one view. An initial data-source mismatch also produced incomplete or inaccurate transaction reporting.

What I changed

Replaced the prior source with the Transaction Details API and reprocessed historical transactions. Built formula-driven calculations for current stock, stock value, 7-day sales velocity, days to stockout, projected stockout date, and reorder dates with urgency indicators. Mapped product variants and SKUs to overarching product families.

Outcome

The client gained a working operating view of profitability, stock health, and reorder urgency built on one defined transaction source. The system was delivered and used in the business, allowing commercial and inventory questions to be investigated without reconciling disconnected exports.
